title: Optimal Weighted $L^2$ Hessian Estimates for Parabolic Equations under General Diffusion Marginals
summary: We study weighted $L^2$ Hessian estimates for parabolic terminal equations under the marginals of a prescribed diffusion, allowing singular initial laws and different principal coefficients in the equation and the diffusion. Under coefficient regularity, uniform ellipticity and bounded reference drift, we characterize the limiting optimal constant uniformly over shrinking subintervals with zero terminal data.
